svg.text: Current title row in EventScene buildLayout(). Title sits too close to the skull beam.
Current 520px body wrap, modeled as a 3-line centered text block. Longer copy grows upward into the frame.
Current feedback/result line area. Shares the same wide left/right span as the body text.
Recommended title safe zone. Roughly 28px lower than the current title row.
Recommended narrative/merchant copy box. Limit wrap to 500px and prefer top-anchored text so extra lines grow downward.
Recommended result/effect box. Keeps green feedback inside the parchment before choices or the Continue button.
